data.narrative:
Auterion, a Series B-stage Defense & Security company, has raised $130M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peer companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two valuation methods are applicable. The Stage-Progression method uses the $130M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $247M. The Peer-Median method references valuations across seven same-sector, same-stage comparables, which span a range of $300M to $3.0B with a median of $1.0B. This wider dispersion reflects heterogeneity within the Defense & Security segment at the Series B stage.

Triangulating these two approaches produces a valuation range of $210M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $624M. The Stage-Progression method anchors the lower bound, while Peer-Median establishes the upper bound. The material gap between methods reflects uncertainty around Auterion's positioning relative to peer growth trajectories, market traction, and technology differentiation—factors not fully captured by stage and sector alone. Further due diligence on revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and technical barriers would help narrow this range.
